description: This class includes the manufacture of machines and equipment used in metallurgical processes.
includes: manufacture of converters, ingot moulds, ladles, casting machines for metallurgical use
manufacture of metal-rolling mills and rolls for such mills
manufacture of machines for drawing metal wire
manufacture of machines for extruding metal
manufacture of furnaces for ore treatment and iron, steel or other metal processing
excludes: manufacture of industrial furnaces not for metallurgical use, see 2815
manufacture of machine tools for working metal, see 2822
